pillow.output: client/public/art/firestorm_fx.png + client/public/art/firestorm_fx.json; client/public/art/firestorm.png (superseded static, kept as lineage evidence, not registered)
pillow.contract: 10 untrimmed 96x96 RGBA frames with 2px atlas gutters; idle, telegraph, charged, active, recovery, two frames each

runtime.note: manifest.js registers runtime key 'firestorm' (matches structureArtKey('FIRESTORM')) pointing at the firestorm_fx.png/.json files -- key and filename are intentionally different, same arrangement as wind_special -> wind_vortex. The earlier static firestorm.png is superseded by this atlas and deliberately left unregistered.
runtime.trigger: StructureAnimator resolves structureArtKey('FIRESTORM') to the generic frame vocabulary. FIRESTORM is the 'volley' family, which has no phase machine: only idle and the cycleSeq-bump active window are reachable, so the packaged telegraph/charged/recovery frames ship but never play (structureBehaviors/volley.js already bumped cycleSeq per volley).

qa.gate: manual Phaser playtest confirmation of aggregate-effect readability remains open; the atlas's telegraph/charged/recovery frames are unreachable for this behavior family and would only become live if FIRESTORM gained a phase machine
